question: Where can I get the planned new power lines and substations in Germany, with location, voltage, planned date and status?

answer.summary: Germany has separate transmission and distribution plans. BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb FeatureServer maps 183 BBPlG/EnLAG transmission sections (Luftlinie, Korridorverlauf, Trassenverlauf). Project sheets and NEP 2037/2045 PDFs add commissioning dates and 871 substation measures. BSH's FEP 2025 WFS/GeoJSON maps offshore platforms and cables. For distribution, 95 of 814 VNBdigital operators have an active plan service. The 2026 XLSX examples checked lack coordinates.
main_caveats: BNetzA and NEP cover transmission. 95 of 814 VNBdigital listings have an active distribution plan service. The exemption for operators below 100,000 customers has an exception for qualifying curtailment under § 14d(8) EnWG.

Substations lack unified official GIS: BNetzA maps 205 unattributed nodes (Vorhabenpunkte) and embeds HVDC converters in line sheets, while NEP's 871 substation Punktmaßnahmen and DSO Umspannwerke are published without coordinates.

Corridor vs route geometry: BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb mixes straight-line node pairs (Luftlinie, 34), federal corridors (Korridorverlauf, 13) and concrete/approved routes (Trassenverlauf, 136); always filter by Typ and Vorhabenst.

Missing dates and voltages in GIS: BNetzA Monitoring_gdb omits commissioning dates (shown on netzausbau.de HTML sheets and NEP PDFs) and sets Spannung='unbekannt' on 23/157 BBPlG features; BSH FEP GeoJSON omits voltage and year.

VNBdigital 2026 XLSX traps: DSO spreadsheets lack coordinates, encode start/commissioning months as Excel serial integers, report voltage tiers (HS, UW HS auf MS, MS, NS) not kV, and some DSOs (e.g. Netze BW) anonymize asset names.
answer.confidence_reason: Directly queried BNetzA ArcGIS FeatureServers, BSH FEP 2025 GeoJSON/WFS, VNBdigital GraphQL and 2026 DSO XLSX tables, NEP 2037/2045 PDFs, ENTSO-E TYNDP 2026 JSON API, OpenStreetMap Overpass, and EnWG §§ 12b, 14d–14e statutory texts.

attributes.note: Exact GIS lines/polygons for BBPlG/EnLAG transmission (corridor vs route) and BSH offshore platforms/cables; NEP substations and VNBdigital DSO plans give names/regions only.
attributes.gap_note: No official coordinates are published for NEP's 871 onshore substation Punktmaßnahmen or VNBdigital's § 14d EnWG distribution measures (PDF raster maps and substation/region names only, with some DSOs such as Netze BW anonymizing measure names); DSOs under 100,000 customers without >3% curtailment are exempt under § 14d Abs. 8 EnWG.

attributes.note: BNetzA GIS/HTML and NEP PDFs report kV (including AC/DC hybrids and 380/110-kV transformers); VNBdigital XLSX gives tier codes (HS, UW HS auf MS, MS, NS); OSM uses Volts.
attributes.gap_note: 23 of 157 BNetzA Vorhaben_BBPlG GIS features state Spannung='unbekannt' (and 1 null), BSH FEP 2025 GeoJSON/WFS and TYNDP 2026 preliminary API omit voltage fields, and VNBdigital XLSX standardizes voltage tiers (HS, MS, NS) rather than kV except in unstandardized prose descriptions.

attributes.note: NEP Projektsteckbriefe, netzausbau.de HTML project sheets and TYNDP give target commissioning years; VNBdigital 2026 XLSX gives expected start and commissioning month/year.
attributes.gap_note: Commissioning dates are absent from BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb ArcGIS FeatureServer, BSH's FEP 2025 GeoJSON/WFS, and NEP's 871-row Punktmaßnahmen substation PDF (which flags only Startnetz vs 2037/2045 scenarios); OSM carries date tags on only 4 of 436 features, and exempt small DSOs publish no § 14d EnWG tables.

attributes.note: BNetzA GIS tracks 6 permitting/construction stages per section; VNBdigital XLSX gives both Projektstatus and permitting stage per DSO asset; TYNDP gives 4 status classes.
attributes.gap_note: NEP's Punktmaßnahmen table distinguishes Startnetz from Zubaunetz without permitting or construction phases. BSH FEP 2025 assigns status='planned' to wind areas and sites. The VNBdigital directory does not establish which operators outside the active plan service publish status tables elsewhere.

attributes.note: BNetzA GIS edited 2026-10-08 (Q2/2026 cut-off, HTML sheets to 2026-11-25); VNBdigital NAP 2026 drafts 2026-10-31; NEP V2025 2nd Draft 2026-03/08; BSH FEP 2025-01-30; TYNDP 2026.
NEP archives biennial plans from 2012 to 2025; BNetzA archives quarterly PDF reports (2013–2026); VNBdigital keeps 2024 PDFs and 2026 XLSX/PDFs; BSH archives FEP 2019–2025.
attributes.gap_note: BNetzA's Monitoring_gdb FeatureServer overwrites geometries in place without historical GIS snapshots, distribution Netzausbaupläne under § 14d EnWG began only in 2024 (no pre-2024 series, and 2024 was PDF-only whereas 2026 added XLSX), and NEP project/measure IDs split or renumber across cycles.

attributes.note: Quarterly BNetzA monitoring (plus continuous web updates); biennial NEP (§ 12b EnWG), DSO NAP by 31 Oct (§ 14d EnWG) and TYNDP; statutory BSH FEP updates; continuous OSM edits.

sources.name: Netzausbau Monitoring_gdb, Vorhabenpunkte & Projektsteckbriefe (netzausbau.de)
sources.format: ArcGIS FeatureServer (JSON / GeoJSON) + HTML project sheets & PDF quarterly reports
sources.license: Copyright Bundesnetzagentur / 50Hertz, Amprion, TenneT, TransnetBW (no open-data license stated)
sources.summary: Official ArcGIS REST FeatureServer behind netzausbau.de mapping statutory BBPlG and EnLAG transmission projects by permitting section, paired with HTML project sheets.
sources.coverage_note: 183 polyline section features (157 BBPlG across 106 statutory projects; 26 EnLAG across 22 projects), of which 138 are planned/in permitting/under construction/completed and 45 already in operation; plus 205 connection nodes in Vorhabenpunkte and 135 HTML project sheets.
caveats: Omits planned commissioning dates in GIS (fetch 'Gesamtinbetriebnahme' from netzausbau.de HTML project sheets) and marks Spannung='unbekannt' on 23/157 BBPlG features.
Covers extra-high-voltage transmission lines only; substations/converters are not standalone attributed GIS records, and Typ mixes Luftlinie (34), Korridorverlauf (13) and Trassenverlauf (136).

sources.name: VNBdigital — Netzausbaupläne der Verteilernetzbetreiber (§§ 14d, 14e EnWG)
sources.format: GraphQL JSON index + operator XLSX spreadsheets (Maßnahmenplan & kompakt) and PDF reports
sources.license: Operator-specific: mostly unstated/all rights reserved; some operators apply CC BY 4.0 to XLSX (e.g. Bayernwerk Netz GmbH) and CC BY-ND 4.0 to PDF
sources.summary: Statutory § 14e EnWG joint portal where obligated electricity DSOs publish biennial § 14d EnWG distribution expansion plans as standardized 2026 XLSX measure spreadsheets and 2024/2026 PDFs.
sources.coverage_note: Of 814 DSOs in the GraphQL directory, 95 have an active plan service ('nap'). Example XLSX downloads contained 1,205 measure rows at Bayernwerk Netz, 15,097 at Westnetz and 18,094 at Netze BW.
caveats: No geographic coordinates are published (substation/line names or anonymized regional labels only; grid maps are static images in PDFs without existing-grid topology).
Exempts DSOs under 100,000 customers unless renewable curtailment exceeded 3% (§ 14d Abs. 8 EnWG); XLSX dates are Excel serial numbers and include completed/cancelled rows.

example.example_request: curl -sL -X POST 'https://www.vnbdigital.de/gateway/graphql' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"query { vnb_gridExpansionDocumentsExternal(vnbId: \"1068\") { uploadDate url metadata { filename version } } }"}'

members_summary.scope_note: 95 of 814 listed electricity DSOs have an active Netzausbauplan ('nap') service on VNBdigital. Ten major regional or urban DSOs across all six planning regions were tested directly. The active count does not establish that every operator made an XLSX file available.
members_summary.pattern: Query vnb_gridExpansionDocumentsExternal(vnbId) on https://www.vnbdigital.de/gateway/graphql or open https://www.vnbdigital.de/vnb/<vnbId> to download NAP_<id>_2026_Entwurf.pdf and NAP_Massnahmen_<id>_2026_Entwurf.xlsx.

sources.name: Netzentwicklungsplan Strom (NEP 2037/2045) — Digitale Projektbibliothek, Projektsteckbriefe & Punktmaßnahmen
sources.publisher: 50Hertz Transmission GmbH, Amprion GmbH, TenneT TSO GmbH, TransnetBW GmbH
sources.format: PDF reports/Steckbriefe + paginated HTML Digitale Projektbibliothek (static PNG maps; no GIS or XLSX measure list)
sources.license: All rights reserved (prior written consent of the TSOs required per Impressum)
sources.summary: Joint TSO statutory transmission plan (§ 12b EnWG) publishing candidate and confirmed projects through 2037/2045 as PDF Steckbriefe and a 40-page substation Punktmaßnahmen report.
sources.coverage_note: 871 unique substation/transformer/switchgear M-code point measures in the downloaded Punktmaßnahmen PDF, plus 272 onshore and offshore transmission projects in the NEP 2037/2045 (2025) 2nd Draft Digitale Projektbibliothek (and archived editions 2012–2023).
caveats: Published as PDFs and HTML pages with static PNG maps only (no CSV/XLSX measure list or GIS routes); copyright reserved by the 4 TSOs.
Punktmaßnahmen substation tables give scenario flags (Startnetz vs 2037/2045) rather than exact commissioning dates or coordinates.

sources.name: Flächenentwicklungsplan für deutsche Seegebiete (FEP 2025) — GeoSeaPortal GeoJSON, GPKG & WFS
sources.format: GeoJSON, GeoPackage (.gpkg) and OGC WFS 2.0.0 / WMS
sources.license: GeoNutzV — Nutzungsbestimmungen für die Bereitstellung von Geodaten des Bundes (Quelle: © BSH 2025)
sources.summary: Federal maritime spatial plan (FEP 2025) serving open GeoJSON, GeoPackage and WFS 2.0.0 geometries for planned offshore grid infrastructure in Germany's EEZ.
sources.coverage_note: 153 spatial features in Germany's EEZ across 9 layers, including 17 offshore converter platform buffers, 3 transformer platform buffers, 36 subsea export/interconnector cable corridors and 28 gates (plus 25 areas, 30 sites, 7 centerlines, 6 zones, 1 other energy area).
caveats: Covers offshore EEZ designations only (1:400,000 scale) and omits voltage and commissioning year fields (join by name_fep with NEP Offshore sheets).
Root JSON file nests 9 separate FeatureCollections by layer key rather than a single top-level features array.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (Overpass API) — Planned and Under-Construction Power Lines & Substations
sources.summary: Crowd-sourced ODbL vector dataset via Overpass API mapping under-construction and proposed power lines, cables and substations with exact coordinates.
sources.coverage_note: 436 OSM elements in Germany (401 construction=line, 21 construction=cable, 7 construction=substation, 4 proposed=line, 2 proposed=cable, 1 proposed=substation); individual ways represent segments/busbars rather than whole projects.
caveats: Captures mainly active construction sites (only 7 proposed elements and 8 substations nationwide) and lacks commissioning dates on 432 of 436 elements.
Voltages are in Volts ('220000' = 220 kV); overpass-api.de returned HTTP 406 to bare CLI clients, so use the maps.mail.ru Overpass mirror or set Accept headers.

problems: Primary instance https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter returned HTTP 406 Not Acceptable to default CLI headers; public mirror https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter served HTTP 200.

if_unstructured.summary: To obtain planned onshore substations (missing from BNetzA GIS), exact commissioning windows for transmission sections, or 110 kV line/substation locations missing from VNBdigital XLSX tables, extract NEP Steckbriefe and Punktmaßnahmen PDFs, netzausbau.de project sheets, DSO Netzausbauplan PDFs, and state permitting dossiers on UVP-Verbund.

local_terms.meaning: Biennial joint transmission grid development plan (§ 12b EnWG) drafted by Germany's 4 TSOs and confirmed by BNetzA.
Biennial distribution grid expansion plan published by larger electricity DSOs on VNBdigital.
Federal statute enacting priority transmission expansion projects monitored by BNetzA on netzausbau.de.
NEP companion category for planned substation switchgear bays, 380/110-kV transformers, loop-ins and reactive compensation.
Federal corridor planning stage under NABEG determining a 500–1,000 m route corridor ('Korridorverlauf') prior to exact route approval.
Final route/site approval decision fixing the binding alignment ('Trassenverlauf') and authorizing construction.
AC transformer substation ('UW') and HVDC AC/DC converter station ('Konverter' / 'Konverterplattform').
BSH federal maritime spatial plan designating offshore converter platforms and subsea export cable corridors in Germany's EEZ.
